basics.name: Ariel Gjaci
basics.label: Postdoctoral Researcher
basics.summary: Postdoctoral Researcher at the Italian Institute of Technology (IIT), working on multimodal generative learning, room acoustics, and spatial audio. My research spans few-shot room impulse response generation, audio-visual scene modeling, human motion generation, and speaker-independent culture modeling. My publications span ECCV, IEEE RO-MAN, and the International Journal of Social Robotics.

work.name: Italian Institute of Technology (IIT)
work.summary: Research with the PAVIS team on the European XTREME project, developing learning-based spatial audio and multimodal models for immersive environments.
highlights: Developing FACT-RIR, a multimodal conditioning framework for few-shot room impulse response generation, using shared room context, query-specific acoustic evidence, and physical priors to guide generative models.
Built a 3D sound-source localization pipeline mapped onto room point clouds using MVDR, DAS, and MaxRE beamforming.
Curating multimodal spatial-audio data and writing a survey on learning-based spatial audio rendering.

work.name: University of Genoa; research collaboration with King's College London
work.summary: Developed culture-aware co-speech gesture generation for social robots, combining multimodal generative models, domain generalization, and semantic gesture labeling.
highlights: Developed rule-based and GAN-based methods for culture-aware co-speech gesture generation on social robots, with publications at AIRO and in the International Journal of Social Robotics.
Analyzed cultural cues in multimodal interactions using classical and deep learning models, including MLPs, SVMs, Random Forests, and VQ-VAEs, with publications at AIRO and AHRI at ACII.
Developed semantic-similarity algorithms for symbolic and deictic gesture labeling, published at IEEE RO-MAN 2024.

Built TED4C-L, a multimodal dataset with 106.45 hours from 764 speakers across four cultural groups, and learned speaker-independent culture embeddings with Fishr regularization and adversarial learning.
Designed ALaDiT, a diffusion-transformer model for culture-aware co-speech motion generation, as part of SICAGE, published at ECCV 2026.

projects.name: FACT-RIR: Few-shot Room Impulse Response Generation (ongoing research)
projects.summary: A multimodal conditioning framework for few-shot room impulse response generation from sparse acoustic observations, geometry, and visual features.
highlights: Learning shared room context and retrieving query-specific acoustic evidence to condition generative models.
Developing conditioning architectures and training strategies that incorporate physical acoustic priors.
